task: Independent review of parent-amended bounded StringBuilder image85
acceptedScope: MC-STRING-BUILDER-P1 only: genuine guest StringBuilder.<init>()V, append(String), and toString(), with the documented null-to-NPE bound and fixed LOCAL limits. This is not acceptance of full Java SE StringBuilder, Minecraft startup, or Done.

confidence.rationale: The review package contains an exact parent-pinned reverse construction, reproducible compiler and runtime pins, generated cross-quantum/reopen evidence, and canonical receipt checks. Independent lightweight inspection confirmed the embedded class size/hash and the exact preservation of all 39 moved prior-tail operations. No heavy gate was rerun, as required.

findings.title: StringBuilder-specific OOM witness is an atomic checkpoint refusal, not a catchable terminal receipt
findings.assessment: This is honest and acceptable under the parent amendment. The witness's live arrays cannot be represented within the unchanged 1 MiB checkpoint, so the gate requires LC0StateError(1,0) with an unchanged root rather than claiming a fabricated catchable result. A separate small field-arena case retains catchable guest OOM coverage. The evidence must continue to be described with this distinction.

findings.title: Acceptance is intentionally narrower than Java SE StringBuilder
findings.assessment: The image deliberately exposes only the no-arg constructor, append(String), and toString(), and null append raises guest NPE instead of appending the literal string 'null'. This is explicitly pinned, tested, and within the assigned bounded scope; it must not be generalized to other constructors, overloads, interfaces, capacity behavior, or full Java compatibility.

assessment.basis: The pinned source allocates an owned empty char array, allocates an exact-length fresh array for each non-null append, copies prior and input UTF-16 code units in order, returns this, and constructs toString via guest String(char[]). The positive fixture checks empty/non-interned output, chained receiver identity, ordered content, distinct outputs, and preservation of the earlier output; the null fixture catches guest NPE.

The root grows from 84 to 85 hashes, image85 is appended after PrintStream, allocation count grows by exactly one, and StringBuilder is added to reserved raw-class names. The generated gate checks initialized and uninitialized states plus atomic raw replacement refusal.

The old post-VFS assignments are moved wholesale into a private internal helper. Solidity memory reference parameters preserve mutation of p.classes, p.classClass, and p.loaderClass across this internal call. Slot formulas and all prior writes remain in the same order; only the final classSlot+45 StringBuilder write is added. The strict verifier reconstructs the expected source mechanically from the pinned parent and requires exact equality.

The build fixes solc 0.8.30, runs 200, viaIR, Cancun, and metadata-off; derives engine and coordinator hashes from built runtimes before rebinding the disposable driver; enforces the 393216-byte runtime cap; and records unchanged raw/checkpoint/frame/gas limits. Domain-separated bootstrap and machine commitments are updated consistently.

The gate checks q1/q7/direct equivalence and reopen, raw30/raw31 and 262144/262145 boundaries, retained System.err/failed-init/EnumSet/ACC_ENUM/queue/OOM controls, and canonical ABI/event/checkpoint/counter/resource-read receipts. The authoritative recovery record reports source verification pass, a 386100-byte runtime with 7116 bytes headroom, 1607 canonical generated receipts, exact prior84 images, and a passed generated gate.
